phases.name: Open the doors
phases.aim: A game that runs, looks decent, and friends can playtest together.

goals.text: Direct co-op with room codes (1–4 players)
Cozy look: café diorama scene
Cozy look: HUD, night screen, title and menus
Roadmap panel on the title screen + suggestion flow
Deployed on GitHub Pages; join with a link and a room code
First game night: 4 friends finish a week

phases.doneWhen: 4 friends in 4 homes finish a full 7-day week with no crash or desync, and 3+ say it looks like a real game.

phases.name: Busy season
phases.aim: Make the rush fun, chaotic and replayable, in the Overcooked spirit.

goals.text: Day events: rush hour, health inspector, power flicker, influencer visit
40+ cards with combos and synergies
Better customers: impatient regulars, big group orders
Difficulty pacing across the week
Sound and juice: dings, steam, coin pops, spill shake
Light local telemetry on what ends runs
Balance pass

phases.doneWhen: The crew asks to play a second week unprompted, and weeks feel different from each other.

phases.name: Real-life growth
phases.aim: A progression that feels like running a real café.

goals.text: Upgrade path: stand → cart → café (register → kiosk → tap terminal)
Parody ads tab (Chirper, InstaGlam, The Daily Grind)
"Pitch an idea" with a scripted keyword judge (no AI)
Simple layout editor between weeks
Unlocks carried between runs

phases.doneWhen: A full run feels like "we started tiny and built something", and every locked night tab is live.

phases.name: Smart café
phases.aim: AI makes the café feel alive, as an option and never required.

goals.text: AI teammates to fill empty slots
AI modes: Off / Lite / Full
Customer and staff dialogue
AI pitch judge
Backend relay within budget (< $20/month, capped per room per day)

phases.doneWhen: A solo player plus 3 AI teammates can finish a week, and switching AI off changes nothing else.

phases.name: Franchise & rivals

goals.text: Campus franchise of several cafés (manager mode)
2v2 rival cafés on a shared street
Seasonal events
Optional friends-only leaderboards

phases.doneWhen: A group can play a "season" across multiple game nights.

changelog.text: UI overhaul round 1: cozy diorama café scene
